summary: EFCAR, LLC filed an 8-K regarding the issuance of asset-backed notes by Exeter Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-4, a securitization trust. The filing details the underwriting agreement with Wells Fargo, BMO, Deutsche Bank, and J.P. Morgan for the sale of notes across classes A-1 through N, totaling over $1 billion, backed by sub-prime auto loans. This is a routine structured finance transaction, not a special situation. The registrant acts as depositor, and the filing covers material agreements and other events. No special-situation elements such as acquisitions, tender offers, or restructuring are present.
